items.question: How are service credits given to Voss-Lindqvist?
items.answer:
Service credits are given to Voss-Lindqvist AB based on the availability of services provided by Harrowgate Systems Inc. According to the Service Credit Side Letter, for each full hour of unavailability below the 99.5% monthly availability threshold, Voss-Lindqvist AB will receive a service credit of five percent (5%) of the monthly subscription fee [1].

Additionally, service credits in any calendar month are capped at twenty-five percent (25%) of the monthly subscription fee for that month [1]. These credits are applied against the next invoice and are not payable in cash [2].

items.answer:

items.question: How are service credits given to Voss-Lindqvist?
items.answer:
Service credits are given to Voss-Lindqvist AB based on the availability of services under the Master Services Agreement. If the provider fails to make the services available at least 99.5% of each calendar month, Voss-Lindqvist AB will receive a service credit of five percent (5%) of the monthly subscription fee for each full hour of unavailability [1].

Service credits are capped at twenty-five percent (25%) of the monthly subscription fee for any calendar month [1]. These credits are applied against the next invoice and are not payable in cash [2].

evidence.quote: Provider will make the Services available at least 99.5% of each calendar month, excluding scheduled maintenance notified at least five (5) business days in advance.
Service credits in any calendar month are capped at twenty-five percent (25%) of the monthly subscription fee for that month.
Credits will be applied against the next invoice and are not payable in cash.
